evidence.range_scope: Original OPEN Q4 statement and exact scope.

pass_condition: Supply a complete proof for every permitted F, or a certified rank-one-convex input and exact impossibility for every allowed gamma, M and omega. Polynomial quartics only; the full planar Morrey/Burkholder question is separate.
priority_rationale: Intake-order review locator only; no numerical scientific importance or likelihood score.
question: For every rank-one-convex homogeneous quartic F on R^{2x2}, do some gamma in [0,gamma_*(F)], constant M>0 with trace 2 and globally closed homogeneous-quadratic two-form omega give the universal compatible-jet positivity inequality in Q4?
title: Resolve closed completion after determinant-square removal for every planar homogeneous quartic
validation_boundary: OPEN source-reported positive proof obligation. Pointwise completion, prior invariant cases, finite dimensions, a failed finite SOS relaxation and uncertified floating signs do not establish or refute Q4.
